colleges.name: DJ Sanghvi College of Engineering
facts: Established in 1994 by the Shri Vile Parle Kelavani Mandal (SVKM)
One of Mumbai's premier engineering institutions
Known for strong industry connections and placements

stories.romantic: DJ Sanghvi has been the starting point for countless friendships, collaborations, and even love stories! The campus buzzes with energy as students work together on innovative projects.
stories.historical: Founded in 1994, DJSCE quickly established itself as a leading engineering college. Named after Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi, a visionary philanthropist, the college has produced thousands of successful engineers who contribute to India's tech industry.
stories.architectural: The modern campus features state-of-the-art laboratories, a well-stocked library, and collaborative spaces where future engineers bring their ideas to life. The campus blends functionality with aesthetics, creating an inspiring learning environment!
